slides.title: 4 things people get wrong about **AI with tools**
slides.scene: A nervous shop owner peeks out from behind a counter at a tiny friendly robot holding a feather duster, as if it were a lion; Phoney the blue phone character stands between them like a lion tamer with a little stool and a whistle, looking amused, while the robot politely waits on a doormat. Bright, warm, funny.
